warning: These are frozen Human Design doctrine claims for prospective testing, not established psychological facts.

profiles.label: Investigator / experimenter
profiles.construct: Builds a secure foundation through investigation, then learns what holds through direct trial, error, and adaptation.

profiles.label: Investigator / networker
profiles.construct: Builds a secure knowledge foundation and transmits or develops it through stable relationships and networks.

profiles.label: Natural / networker
profiles.construct: Needs private withdrawal for natural capacities to develop and is called into opportunities through familiar relationships.

profiles.label: Natural / projected solver
profiles.construct: Develops natural capacity in privacy while others project practical problem-solving expectations onto that capacity.

profiles.label: Experimenter / projected solver
profiles.construct: Discovers workable solutions through trial and error while managing strong external expectations for practical results.

profiles.label: Experimenter / role model
profiles.construct: Moves from experiential trial and error toward observation, perspective, and eventual embodied example across life phases.

profiles.label: Networker / role model
profiles.construct: Opportunities arise through trusted relationships while the life trajectory develops toward perspective and embodied example.

profiles.label: Networker / fixed investigator
profiles.construct: Influences through stable relationships from a comparatively fixed, deeply investigated foundation.

profiles.label: Projected solver / investigator
profiles.construct: Is projected upon as a practical solver and needs a sufficiently investigated foundation before offering universalized solutions.

profiles.label: Projected solver / natural
profiles.construct: Combines projected practical expectations with a private natural capacity that cannot be reliably summoned on demand.

profiles.label: Role model / natural
profiles.construct: Develops through distinct life phases toward an embodied example while retaining a need for privacy and natural emergence.

profiles.label: Role model / experimenter
profiles.construct: Develops perspective and embodied example through an unusually persistent relationship with experimentation and adaptation.
